details:
1. Create menu item set as int (for a toggle)

2. Set to non 0-1 value (eg 4)

3. Convert parameter type to Bool in the parameters menu

4. Upload (as gesturemanager and avatar3.0 both do not seem to replicate)

Upon upload it will not properly sync the menu to show that the toggle is active, however the bool will be set to true(or 1 with a mismatched float in its place)

This has only been replicated on PC

Git diff between working and non working menu items
